description:
<!-- Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-17. -->
## YouTube

- **Search comments (#58):** Keep the search button out of Description and other non-comment panels.
  Search remains available in comments.
- **Video action bar layout (#59):** Show the dislike icon again in **Classic One-Row** and
  **Classic Two-Rows**, with or without Return YouTube Dislike.
- **Shorts custom actions:** Show **Download** and other enabled custom actions again when YouTube opens
  the three-dot menu as a small pop-up, including on experimental **21.45.90**. The bottom-sheet menu
  stays unchanged.
